verdict.rationale: Dagster documents some bulk actions of its own. Dynamic partitions can be wiped and deleted in a single action, including on multi-partitioned assets, and users can run subsets of many dbt models, seeds and snapshots from the UI or APIs. The evidence is changelog-level and narrow, with no general bulk-operation feature described. Missing for 10: general documentation of bulk actions across runs and assets (e.g., bulk re-execution, cancel or materialize), agent- or CLI-driven bulk operations via MCP or dg, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: wiping and deleting dynamic partitions in a single action now also supports multi-partitioned assets that use the dynamic partitions definition as a dimension
Use Dagster's UI or APIs to run subsets of your dbt models, seeds, and snapshots.
